title: Events and run modifiers
description: Event definitions and the run modifiers a Shrine offers (W2-3). An event's type names a handler in the session package; params are read only by that handler. Modifier effects are copied into the team state when taken. All values are placeholders to tune.

offerCount.description: How many events are offered at each event step.

fromRound.description: The first round this event may be offered. Absent means 1. An always-available event (Windfall) must not set it above 1.

resourceWeights.description: Rich vein and Caravan only: the weight of each base resource in the draw of the offer's resource (the Caravan's Node reward), by resource ID (Ore and Power common, Flux rare, like map nodes). Every key must be a base resource of the resources file.

params.description: Numbers and strings read by the event type's handler.

workshopPricePercent.description: Workshop only: the percentage of the shop price (at the tier being raised to) a player pays to raise one of their buildings by one tier. Rounded down.

extraOffers.description: Market day only: how many more offers than shopOfferCount each player's next shop makes.

gold.description: Caravan only: the gold of the Gold reward.

weightGold.description: Caravan only: the weight of the Gold reward in the draw of each reward (0 leaves it out).

weightBuilding.description: Caravan only: the weight of the free tier-1 building reward (at least 1, so a draft can always be filled).

weightUpgrade.description: Caravan only: the weight of the free tier raise reward (0 leaves it out).

weightNode.description: Caravan only: the weight of the resource node reward (0 leaves it out; above 0 needs resourceWeights).

weightModifier.description: Caravan only: the weight of the party-wide run modifier reward (0 leaves it out).

freeRerolls.description: Market day only: how many re-rolls in each player's next shop cost 0.

fromRound.description: The first round the Shrine may offer this modifier. Absent means 1.

pact.description: True for a pact: a modifier with a benefit and a drawback (at least one positive and one negative effect, not stackable) that only the Pact event gives; the Shrine never offers it.

percent.description: An integer from -90 to 1000, never 0. A negative percent is a drawback; the simulation raises a sum below minModifierSumPercent (sim.json) to it.

effect.description: One effect of a modifier; the simulation applies percent bonuses in integers, rounded down.

units.description: The unit types the bonus applies to: unit IDs in the order of the units file, no duplicates. Absent means every unit type.
